notes: Single VAT rate 17% (Indirect Taxation Authority). The authority's complete VAT-exempt activities list was read in full (public-interest, financial, transport): gold and investment gold appear nowhere, so bullion takes 17%; silver likewise. Import duty 0%: the Council of Ministers' 2026 Customs Tariff (mvteo.gov.ba) shows 0 in every rate column for all HS 7108 lines.

sources.name: Indirect Taxation Authority (uino.gov.ba) - General information on the VAT system in Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the BiH VAT rate is 17%; the page's exempt-activities list contains no gold item

sources.name: Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Relations (mvteo.gov.ba) - Customs Tariff 2026 (Council of Ministers Decision)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: HS 7108 lines (powder, other unwrought forms, semi-manufactured, monetary) all carry 0 in every duty column
